about: The music library media-render bundles (PRD-251 S1.6). The image build fetches every track from its url and fails when a sha256 differs, then analyses each into cue windows (media_render/music_build.py). No audio file is committed to git. A track is CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0; a CC BY track's attribution is the credit line every post that uses it carries. Adding a track is the owner's call (PRD-251 open question 5).
